prs.title: fix(server): allow JSON Accept in JSON response mode
prs.author: Genmin
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both PRs fix the same bug in webStandardStreamableHttp.ts: JSON response mode was rejecting valid requests unless the Accept header listed BOTH application/json and text/event-stream, per the old strict check `!acceptHeader?.includes('application/json') || !acceptHeader.includes('text/event-stream')`. Clients that legitimately send only `Accept: application/json` in JSON response mode were incorrectly getting a 406. Both changesets describe the identical fix and both touch the exact same code region (~line 598-610). PR #2204 (parsedBody null vs undefined handling for AWS Lambda/serverless-express) is a different code path and root cause, so it is not part of this cluster. (2 PRs)

prs.cluster_pick_reason: 1996 replaces the check with a dedicated acceptsMediaType() parser that follows RFC 7231 media-type matching: it splits on ';' to strip/inspect parameters, explicitly excludes entries with q=0, and compares type/subtype pairs (supporting wildcards) rather than doing raw substring matching. 2046's visible implementation instead does `acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')`, a plain substring check that would false-positive on any Accept value containing that substring as a prefix of a different media type (e.g. `application/json-patch+json`), which 1996's structured parser avoids by design.
